name: Telco: routing zgłoszeń
description: Routes Polish mobile/fixed-line operator customer messages to the correct department, including messages with embedded prompt injections.
instructions: Which department should handle this customer message?

criteria.billing: Invoices, charges, payments, refunds, prices on the bill
criteria.technical_mobile: Mobile network coverage, calls, SMS, mobile data, SIM, eSIM, roaming not working
criteria.technical_fixed: Home internet, fibre, router, TV decoder, landline faults
criteria.contract: New contract, extension, tariff change, termination, number porting, add-ons
criteria.device: Phone or equipment purchase, instalments, delivery, warranty, repair
criteria.other: None of the above (general questions, praise, unrelated messages)
